# Town of Westmore municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names David Stevens (Chair), William Perkins (Vice Chair), Miriam Simonds, Isaiah Casey, and Jason Petrarca
Town of Westmore, Selectboard page: names the same five members with term expiries -- Stevens (2027), Casey (2027), Simonds (2028), Petrarca (2028), Perkins (2029)

Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: the pre-meeting table showed Peter Hyslop's seat expiring in 2026; the live board page seats Jason Petrarca in it
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Elaine Cashin as Westmore's Town Clerk
Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: Town Clerk Elaine Cashin, three-year term to 2028
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists John Zimmer as Westmore's Town Treasurer
Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: Town Treasurer John Zimmer, three-year term to 2028

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds
Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: Trustee of Public Funds John Zimmer, term to 2028 -- the town elects a single trustee
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers
Town of Westmore, Listers page: names Susan Blackstone, Maree Bushey, and Amanda Smith as the current listers

Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: listers Susan Blackstone (2027) and Maree Bushey (2028); the third seat, John Zimmer's, expired in 2026 and the live page seats Amanda Smith (to 2029)
Town of Westmore, Cemetery page: names Miriam Simonds and William Perkins as commissioner contacts
Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: Cemetery Commissioners Stephen Davenport (2027), William Perkins (2028), and Miriam Simonds (2029)
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: Moderator Andrew Berley, one-year term expiring 2026. The March 2026 outcome is unpublished, so no holder is minted; Berley is carried as a straggler on issue #163

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Westmore justices of the peace: Alison J Valley, Christine Evans, Kathy L Homes, Linda Michniewicz, and Joanna Burgess
Town of Westmore, Justices of the Peace page: names the same five, printing the third as Kathy Holmes

Town of Westmore, 2025 Town Report (dated February 23, 2026), ELECTED OFFICIALS table: the justices of the peace table also prints Kathy Holmes. Both town sources give 'Holmes' where the certified listing gives 'Homes'; the person is minted as Kathy Holmes with the certified form kept as her ballot name
